back.target: at the, while (doing something) (contraction of bei + dem)
back.example: While eating, I like to watch series.

note: The hint says "before a noun", but "eating" is a verb in English, so it could say "before a verb used as a noun (das Essen)" to make the beim + nominalized infinitive pattern clearer; this clearly separates the card from the "[at the] doctor's" card.
